name: OPIM 6202
title: Seminar in Operations Management
description: Introduces doctoral students to the current research concerns in the field of Operations Management. The course will also acquaint students with the variety of research tools used in the field, enable them to critically evaluate the research of other scholars in the field as well as to develop research skills in identifying potential research problems to be analyzed. May be repeated for a total of 12 credits.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
